products.title: SkinLuxe High Waisted Legging - Navy
products.body_html:
Our second-skin feel, high waisted leggings are designed to stay up whether you’re running, stretching or squatting. With super flattering, sweet-heart contouring and reflective branding, and featuring a discreet and secure back zip pocket for keeping your phone safe during your workouts, these versatile and high-performing leggings are perfect for on the move. Pair with just about anything in your workout and going out wardrobe. 

  • High waisted design
  • Available in full leg length (27 inch)
  • Buttery-smooth, lightweight material 
  • Zip pocket at the rear for essentials
  • Sustainably made from 76% recycled nylon and 24% LYCRA® SPORT

Sizes XL-4XL:

Instead of just grading everything up from our original sizes, we have made the necessary amendments to offer a comfortable and flattering fit for real bodies. Modifications for this style include:

  • Amended waistband depth to sit at a more flattering part of waist while keeping the top edge of waistband in the same position.

 

Responsibility:

This item is made from Recycled Nylon from pre-consumer waste (aka factory offcuts) certified by the Global Recycle Standard.

  • Energy saving =  71-80%. 
  • Water  saving = 54-58%
